## Course Resources

::: section-intro
All required readings, slide decks, and tools used in this course. Where
possible, open-access versions are linked. For readings behind paywalls,
enrolled students should access materials through their institutional
library.
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Core Readings by Block

No required reading is assigned in any session; sources cited on the slides serve as background/citation material
rather than mandatory pre-reading. The tables below list each session's optional / going-deeper readings.

### Session 01 — Introduction to Sustainable Development

| Reading | Access |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| Meadows et al. (1972). *The Limits to Growth*. | Library |
| World Commission on Environment and Development (1987). *Our Common Future* (Brundtland Report). | Library |
| Raworth, K. (2017). *Doughnut Economics*. | Library / purchase |
| Pascual et al. (2023). Diverse values of nature for sustainability. *Nature*. | Library |
| World Economic Forum (2023). *The Global Risks Report 2023*. | [Open access](https://www.weforum.org/publications/global-risks-report-2023/) |
| Global Sustainable Development Report 2023 (UN). | [Open access](https://sdgs.un.org/gsdr/gsdr2023) |

### Session 02 — Interlinkages of Sustainability Dimensions and Role of Science & Higher Education

| Reading | Access |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| Jahn, Bergmann & Keil (2012). Transdisciplinarity: Between mainstreaming and marginalization. | Library |
| Schneider & Buser (2018). Promising degrees of stakeholder interaction in research for sustainable development. | Library |
| Herweg et al. (2021). *Transdisciplinary Learning for Sustainable Development* (textbook). | Library |
| Herweg et al. (2017). Integrating Sustainable Development into Higher Education, Guidelines for the University of Bern. | Library |
| SDG "wedding cake" animation (Stockholm Resilience Centre). | [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=SDG+wedding+cake+Stockholm+Resilience+Centre) |
| Price et al. (2021). Supporting the role of universities in leading individual and societal transformation through ESD. | Library |

### Session 03 — Education for Sustainable Development (ESD) & Constructive Alignment

| Reading | Access |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| Rieckmann, M. (2018). Learning to transform the world: Key competencies in Education for Sustainable Development. | Library |
| Tejedor et al. (2019). Didactic strategies to promote competencies in sustainability. | Library |
| Herweg et al. (2021). *Transdisciplinary Learning for Sustainable Development* (textbook, chapter on constructive alignment). | Library |
| UNESCO (2023). What you need to know about education for sustainable development. | [Open access](https://www.unesco.org/en/education-sustainable-development/need-know) |
| UNESCO. Berlin Declaration on Education for Sustainable Development (2021). | [Open access](https://unesdoc.unesco.org/ark:/48223/pf0000381228) |

### Session 04 — Presentation of Action Plans

No optional readings assigned. The core material of this session is each participant's own completed ESD Action
Plan (Tasks after Sessions 1-3).

## Useful Tools and Databases

**Sustainability data**

- [Global Footprint Network](https://www.footprintnetwork.org) —
  ecological footprint and biocapacity by country
- [Our World in Data](https://ourworldindata.org) — open data on energy,
  food, inequality, health
- [Stockholm Resilience
  Centre](https://www.stockholmresilience.org/research/planetary-boundaries.html)
  — planetary boundaries updates
- [Environmental Justice Atlas](https://ejatlas.org) — global database
  of environmental conflicts

**Teaching tools**

- [Kumu](https://kumu.io) — systems mapping tool (free tier available)
- [Loopy](https://ncase.me/loopy/) — simple interactive causal loop
  diagrams, browser-based and free
- [Mentimeter](https://www.mentimeter.com) — live polls, quizzes, and
  word clouds for in-session interaction
- [Padlet](https://padlet.com) — collaborative digital pinboard for
  group brainstorming
- [Miro](https://miro.com) — online whiteboard for collaborative
  mapping and workshops

**Systems thinking**

- [Kumu](https://kumu.io) — systems mapping tool (free tier available)
- [Loopy](https://ncase.me/loopy/) — simple interactive causal loop
  diagrams, browser-based and free

**Academic search**

- [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com)
- [BASE (Bielefeld Academic Search Engine)](https://www.base-search.net)
  — strong for open-access
- [Unpaywall browser extension](https://unpaywall.org) — finds legal
  open-access versions of paywalled papers
